label: Review Avatars
purpose: Display customer avatars with verified badges and review stat text for social proof
_notes:
Shows up to 5 customer avatar images with an optional verified checkmark badge each (avatar_N_verified), plus two independent two-line text groups (text_1_line_1/text_1_line_2 and text_2_line_1/text_2_line_2) — e.g. '2,847 reviews' / 'Trusted by pet parents'. All text fields are inline_richtext: do NOT wrap in

tags, use / for emphasis. Leave text_2_line_1/text_2_line_2 empty to show only the first text group. Avatar images are left empty by the AI per system prompt and filled by the image-generation step. All remaining real settings (enable custom layout, alignment, corner radius, avatar size/offset/position, checkmark and star colors/sizes, an anchor-link scroll id, per-text background/border/padding/offset/mobile-size overrides, margins) are pure visual styling, omitted.
